execution_note: Run against the exact m1 commit and attach raw PHPUnit/Postman/DB logs before QA sign-off.

test_cases.scenario: Create SKU with valid component and physical code
test_cases.expected: 201; products, component, code, audit and idempotency snapshot commit together

test_cases.scenario: Retry exact SKU create with same key and canonical payload
test_cases.expected: Exact response replay; no duplicate rows or audit; Idempotent-Replay=true

test_cases.scenario: Reuse same key with changed SKU payload
Create direct self reference
Create transitive cycle A->B->C->A
test_cases.expected: 422 SKU_COMPONENT_CYCLE; edge, version and audit unchanged

test_cases.scenario: Duplicate component or quantity <= 0
Two concurrent SKUs assign one physical code
Two updates use the same SKU version
test_cases.expected: One commits and increments once; loser 409 SKU_VERSION_CONFLICT

test_cases.scenario: Force both audit and audit-outbox write failure
test_cases.expected: Business transaction fails; aggregate rows roll back

test_cases.scenario: Create container with valid bulk item
test_cases.expected: Root, items, audit and snapshot commit together

test_cases.scenario: Duplicate item_key in create payload
test_cases.expected: 422 DUPLICATE_CONTAINER_ITEM; root, item and audit absent

test_cases.scenario: Two containers claim one active serial concurrently
Containerize ISSUED or RETURNED_TO_CUSTOMER serial
Container and serial or parent use different warehouses
Create self-parent or transitive parent cycle
Seal empty container
Update items, location or parent after SEALED
Two updates use the same container version
Missing permission or unauthenticated
test_cases.expected: 403 or 401; no data or audit side effect

test_cases.scenario: Trigger validation and business conflicts
test_cases.expected: Canonical envelope with request_id; no secret, SQL, file path or stack trace
